edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: older adults and medically complex adults
edges.mechanism: Low muscle mass reduces mobility, respiratory reserve, and recovery capacity, which explains why sarcopenia predicts harder hospital courses.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2024 Bertelsen rct in Trials, which ties sarcopenia to hospitalisation in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
